name: skin_weights
does: New skin weights for a rigged model with its skeleton kept (same joints and names, so its controls and clips still drive it): SkinTokens, a learned skinning model (MIT), run on Kaggle's free GPU - for creatures where bone heat or a voxel bind tears where parts touch. Writes the weights (.npz: 4 joints a vertex) and the model re-skinned. Needs Kaggle connected; takes about half an hour

model.description: the rigged model (.fbx or .glb with its skeleton and mesh), e.g. renders/dragon_as.fbx

model_out.description: the model re-skinned with them (.fbx or .glb)

minutes.description: how long to wait for Kaggle

max_joints.description: the most joints it skins (twist helpers sit out above this)
